review: Reviewed complete production module and tests. Requires fixed 12-method roster, at least three seeds, full source/seed/method denominator, score/cost completeness, pinned registration and cohort firewall. Uses fractional CVaR and 15 paired source-cluster bootstrap contrasts with Bonferroni intervals. Missing/over-budget observations retain zero quality and severe loss; all paths keep model_promotion_authorized false. CLI defaults retain 128 sources and 2000 bootstrap draws; synthetic unit overrides are not production results.
